capabilities: Chat with DeepSeek models in a sidebar
Run web and deep searches with citations and sources
Read pasted links and attach vault files or images
Read replies aloud and transcribe voice input
Search, read and edit vault notes through tools
extras: Unofficial project, not affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek. The plugin is free but usage is billed by DeepSeek, including search, link reading, document parsing, text-to-speech and speech input. The API key is stored in plain text in data.json. Beta builds are available through BRAT.
problem: Chatting with DeepSeek normally happens outside Obsidian, so the current note, selected text and vault files cannot be sent along with a question.

relations.evidence: Chat with DeepSeek in an Obsidian sidebar using your own API key.
With BRAT (beta builds): install BRAT, choose Add beta plugin

summary: Sidebar chat client for DeepSeek's API with web search, link and file reading, text-to-speech, voice input and vault note tools.
